corpus.label: scope A
corpus.description: the wiki of a management software (Italian, screenshots)
corpus.source: a markdown export of the wiki, imported as it is
corpus.images_detail: 15,044 screenshots and 1,808 icons described by a vision model; 23 SVG not described

precise.how: generated by a local model (Qwen3 32B) from single passages, each anchored to a document and a section, reviewed by two other local models

broad.how: one per document, from its broadest part (1,500-8,000 characters), generated by Qwen3 14B and approved by Gemma 4 12B

gpu_host.use: every model: embeddings, reranker, answers, judges, image descriptions, OCR models
gpu_host.rule: everything stays in the 16 GB of VRAM, nothing offloaded to the CPU

cpu_host.use: gosidian, the plugins, Qdrant and PostgreSQL, the converters that run on the CPU

config.value: a markdown export of a wiki, imported as it is (in.import)
screenshots: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct FP8 on vLLM, at least 1 MP; icons: Gemma 4 12B QAT w4a16, prompt v3; the text of each image in place in the chunk
note.sections, paragraphs only; sections kept as parents and paths
Qwen3-Embedding-8B (Ollama, Q4_K_M), official instruction, cut to 2048 numbers; queries through a 512-token-context id of the same weights
Qdrant 1.19.1, HNSW with ef 128, payload indexes on the version fields
bge-reranker-v2-m3 Q8_0 on llama-server, 20 candidates, max_chars 4000, without the title
k 5 paragraphs; each brings its whole section, up to 24,000 characters; images of the sources placed in the answer
gemma4:12b (Ollama, Q4_K_M), context 12,288 tokens, max_tokens 1000, no reranker threshold
gosidian v2.94.0 (development build), database plugin 0.5.0; Ollama 0.40.3, llama.cpp b11540, vLLM 0.31.0
one RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB for every model; AMD Ryzen 7 5700G for gosidian and the stores
